run_densepose_visualization: run the script to visualize SMPL body mesh fits rendered with densepose on input images
run_export_densepose_labels: run the script with --export to save densepose u, v, and segmentation labels as pickle files
run_headless_densepose_rendering: run the script with --bNoVis for headless rendering without displaying images on screen
run_densepose_with_colormode: run the script with --colormode set to u, v, or seg to choose the rendering color mode
review_densepose_renderer_usage: review how denseposeRenderer is used to set SMPL mesh vertices, viewport size, and retrieve screen color output
